name: Osmious-Nunatak
description: The crust never rests here. Rivers of incandescent basalt vein the lowlands, ash climbs from vents along every fault, and beyond an exposed planetary core the sky stays the color of a bruise.

There is a hush that is not emptiness but attention, as if the landscape were listening back. Visitors report dreams of falling that persist for days after departure. Glass-bladed grasses chime across the plains whenever the wind finds its voice.
Local legend among spacers says the planet hums on a frequency just below hearing. Instruments confirm it. Nobody agrees on the source.
The next expedition is already fitting out. Whether it returns with data, ore, or just debts depends on choices nobody has made yet.
